conditions: Allgate Terms §3 allow service resale only as expressly permitted in writing or through its partner program. Partner access requires review, approval, and provisioning; submitting an application itself creates no partner rights or pricing.

Obtain and review the specific approved partner agreement and account scope, including eligible downstream users, markets, partner-only models, quotas, rate limits, pricing, markup rules, settlement and customer support before any route is eligible.
Do not reuse promotional/bonus credits as reseller inventory; Terms distinguish promotional credits from purchased funds and allow expiry/withdrawal after abuse.

Allgate is the gateway, not the underlying model provider. For each exact model, capture the actual third-party serving provider, its terms/policies, publisher/model license, and current permitted use.

Catalog model count, listed prices, API docs, and general account/API access do not prove partner permission, model supply under an approved account, or live capacity; use partner catalog and fresh route availability evidence after authorized provisioning.
Wholesale rates, effective retail prices, settlement and commission are individually confirmed; public model prices are not partner wholesale rates or approved Vrooli customer prices.
plan_rules.reason: The Partner Program expressly supports reviewed reseller/integrator downstream customer accounts, customer keys, per-model retail pricing and earnings, while the base Terms bar resale except through that program or written permission. Individual review and commercial terms are prerequisites, so this is a conditional proposal only.
